name: 33069 · Pompano Beach, FL
findings: ZIP 33069 (Pompano Beach) has 126 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33069 (Pompano Beach) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
51% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
